searchText: I have some basic beginner-level questions on Phase 1. Q1) Since shard state transition is deferred to Phase 2, what do shard's state contain in Phase 1? Am I correct in saying that they will never change? <@!689635476826619924> there will be `gasprice` to track the gas price for proposing the next shard data block. And `slot` number & `latest_block_root` to record the info of the latest shard block. But no account-level states on shard chain
